name: Heroslayer Hydra

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Heroslayer
traits.details: While a heroslayer hydra is marked, it gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +5 bonus to damage rolls against the creature that marked it.

traits.name: Many-Headed
traits.details: Each time a heroslayer hydra would become dazed or stunned, it instead loses one attack while using hydra fury during its next turn. The hydra can be dazed or stunned multiple times.

traits.name: Regenerating Heads
traits.details: When a heroslayer hydra first reaches 582, 388, and 194 hit points, a head is destroyed. At the start of the hydra’s next turn after a head is destroyed, two heads grow in the lost head’s place, and the hydra gains an additional bite attack with hydra fury.

traits.name: Threatening Reach
traits.details: A heroslayer hydra can make opportunity attacks against all enemies within its reach (3 squares).

effect.description: The heroslayer hydra makes five bite attacks, plus an additional attack for each head it has grown (see regenerating heads). A target hit by more than one bite attack in a round takes 10 extra damage

powers.name: Rampage
powers.usageDetails: when a critical hit is scored against the heroslayer hydra

effect.description: The hydra makes one bite attack against each enemy within reach. On a hit, the target takes ongoing 10 damage (save ends)
